summary: Recompile an object's program in place according to the current driver semantics and return the number of affected objects.
details: Recompile the program definition of a loaded object to refresh its code during development. The caller must handle object-state migration, rollback on failure, and the order in which related dependent objects are refreshed.
note: The hot_reload daemon in the testsuite is a development example; it does not mean every project enables hot reloading by default.
